help.article.gs1.title: Getting started on Creatyng
help.article.gs1.content: After creating your account, open the dashboard and click "New Creative". You'll be guided through a 4-step wizard: upload your product photo, choose the visual style, fill in the text and click Generate. In seconds, the AI delivers an agency-level creative.
help.article.cr1.title: Step by step: creating your first creative
help.article.cr1.content:
1. On the "Create" screen, upload your product photo (PNG, JPG or WEBP up to 10MB).
2. Choose between Food Pop (vibrant food visuals) or Pop Design (bold graphic design).
3. Fill in the title, price and CTA. The AI builds the composition automatically.
4. On the result screen, you can export in 2K or use the refinement chat for tweaks.
help.article.ps1.title: Understanding style presets
help.article.ps1.content:
Creatyng offers style presets that define your creative visual atmosphere:
- Food Pop: vibrant colors, energetic backgrounds, perfect for restaurants and delivery.
- Pop Design: bold graphic design with pop-art elements, ideal for striking campaigns.
Each preset automatically configures lighting, color palette and composition.
help.article.ch1.title: How to use the refinement chat
help.article.ch1.content: After generating your creative, an AI chat appears on the result screen. Describe what you want to adjust: "change the background to blue", "make the text bigger", "add more contrast". The AI will interpret your instruction and generate a new version. Each tweak costs 1 credit.
help.article.cd1.title: How credits work
help.article.cd1.content:
Each action in Creatyng has a credit cost:
- Food Pop: 5 credits per generation
- Pop Design: 8 credits
- Refinement chat: 1 credit per tweak
- Export: free
You receive credits based on your plan (Free: 100/mo, Pro: 1000/mo). Extra credits can be purchased on the Billing page.
help.article.ac1.title: Account and profile settings
help.article.ac1.content:
Open Settings in the side menu to:
- Profile: change name, photo and phone
- Preferences: language, theme (light/dark), default format
- Brand Kit: set your brand colors and fonts
- API Keys: manage integration keys
All changes are saved automatically.
help.article.faq1.title: Frequently asked questions
help.article.faq1.content: See the most common questions below. If you can't find your answer, reach out at support@creatyng.com.

wizard.s1.ref_tip: The post, ad or art you want to clone. It can be a screenshot from any social network.

wizard.s1.subject_tip: Photo of your product or person to replace what appears in the reference. If you don't upload one, the AI keeps the original.
wizard.s1.logo_tip: Your logo will be inserted into the creative, replacing any logo placeholder in the reference.
